notes.title: Abglantz Demo Update 2025.1 !
notes.content: [p]Another big Abglantz Demo Update is finally here!  Version 2025.1.[/p][p]Too many changes to list...[/p][p][/p][p]some highlights: [/p][p]- lots of user experience improvements (gui, sound, etc.)[/p][p]- some visual improvements (maps, effects)[/p][p]- gibs cause blood effects[/p][p]- option to keep decals permanently (even saved)[/p][p]- fixed a bad bug that could resize menus to zero[/p][p]- new headshot system (certain weapons only, try the minigun)[/p][p]- much more [/p]

notes.title: Abglantz Demo update!
notes.content:
A big Abglantz Demo update is finally here!

too many changes to list...

some highlights:
- three new maps in the demo (including tutorial)
- drastically improved performance
- many additional options
- many improvements to maps, models and gameplay
- improved ai
- fixed a very problematic sound file (thx sjellos)
- much more

this took a while, thank you for your patience...
